description: Design forward and reverse PCR primers flanking a target region with Primer3's pair search (verified against primer3-py design_primers): per-primer limits (length, GC%, Primer3-default SantaLucia Tm, poly-X, dinucleotide repeat) plus, by default, Primer3's thermodynamic structure screen (ntthal self-dimer, 3' self-dimer, hairpin Tm <= 47 °C); pairs need a product size in product_size_range (default 100-300 bp), |ΔTm| <= max_tm_difference (default 5 °C) and pair hetero-dimer / 3' hetero-dimer Tm <= 47 °C; returns the lowest Primer3 pair penalty pair, its product Tm and complementarity, an optional internal hybridization oligo and up to num_return ranked pairs.

target_start.description: 0-based inclusive start of the target region.

target_end.description: 0-based exclusive end of the target region (target_start < target_end < template.Length).

parameters.description: Optional primer-design parameters (lengths, GC%, Tm, repeats, GC-clamp/3' stability checks, structure screen and its Tm limit).

product_size_range.description: PRIMER_PRODUCT_SIZE_RANGE in Primer3 syntax, e.g. "100-300" or "150-250 100-400" (ranges in order of preference; default 100-300).

max_tm_difference.description: PRIMER_PAIR_MAX_DIFF_TM: maximum |Tm_forward - Tm_reverse| in °C (default 5; Primer3's own default is 100).

num_return.description: PRIMER_NUM_RETURN: number of ranked pairs listed in 'pairs' (default 1).

pick_internal_oligo.description: PRIMER_PICK_INTERNAL_OLIGO: also pick an internal hybridization oligo strictly between the primers (Primer3 PRIMER_INTERNAL_* defaults).

isValid.description: True when a compatible pair was found.

internalOligo.description: PRIMER_INTERNAL_0_* (sequence, start, length, tm, gcPercent, selfAnyTh, selfEndTh, hairpinTh, penalty) when pick_internal_oligo.

pairs.description: Ranked valid pairs (PRIMER_PAIR_k, k < num_return), each with forward, reverse, productSize, pairPenalty, productTm, complAnyTh, complEndTh, internalOligo; empty when no pair qualifies.

errors.message: Template cannot be null or empty
Target end must be within the template
Target start must be strictly less than target end
